description.content: Full text search across DVIDS news, video, image, audio, publications, webcasts, and graphics.
Retrieve extended information about a specific media asset.
Retrieve media assets related to a specified asset.
Search the DVIDS unit directory by name, abbreviation, branch, or ID.

The Defense Visual Information Distribution Service (DVIDS) API provides programmatic access to U.S. military news, photos, video, audio, publications, units, and live events. The API is implemented as JSON over HTTP and requires a public API key.
